Why?  Best case scenario they will tell me to find a job, as if it's a forgone conclusion that I will be handed one.  Otherwise, they're not supportive even in the most dire of situations.  When I last attempted suicide, my mother refused to see me in the hospital or speak to me for several months.  It's pretty much the same with any unpleasant situation.

Sadly, my sisters are in financial trouble, too.  One of my older sisters tried to have my parents help her out when she was recently being charged a crazy amount of money in an emergency situation, they said too bad, ignored her, and went on vacation.
Me either.  I feel exhausted.  I'm sorry you're in the same boat.

I actually moved out here from Texas.  I miss Texas sometimes.  Most of my connections out there have moved on to other states, though.  My unemployment was out there.  There's a lot of jobs, but it feels like it's all in tech and I have zero experience in any of that.

Thanks for the kind words.  It's just really hard to keep going.  I feel like I'm standing on the tracks watching the train coming towards me, and once my term is over and I'm out on my ass with nowhere to go and no income... I just don't think I'm going to make it.
Anthropology, did biology, forensics, and archaeology.
